build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that creates a physics scene with jars, balls, and bars
add_scene_objects: create dynamic jars, balls, and static bars in the PHYRE scene using C.add
update_task_relationships: define a touching relationship between two bodies using C.update_task with SpatialRelationship
set_solution_tier: set the task metadata to SolutionTier.BALL using C.set_meta
skip_template_params: raise SkipTemplateParams to exclude invalid parameter combinations from the task search space
